counterexample.positions: [100, 200) with liquidity L and [50, 300) with liquidity L2
counterexample.explanation: Active liquidity is L + L2 at tick 100 and L2 at tick 50. The repair keeps the start tick only if its net liquidity is non-zero and the next initialized tick below it in the same word is not the end tick. Here getNextTickLt(100) finds tick 50, which equals the end tick, so tick 100 is skipped and the result stays L + L2.

summary: The repair keeps currentTick at the start tick only when that tick has non-zero gross and net liquidity and the next initialized tick below it in the same bitmap word is not the end tick. Start ticks whose next lower tick is the end tick, or whose net liquidity is zero, are still skipped.
